name: Olympiades Féminines / 1er Meeting International d'Éducation Physique Féminine (Women's Olympiad)
venue: Tir aux Pigeons, Casino gardens (International Sporting Club)
notes: Dates are the festival's (Gallica blog says 23-31, Monaco NOC 25-30). Rol photos date athletics to 26-27 Mar: 60m final on the 26th, 250m on the 27th. 60m had semis. Hurdles 74m (Delapierre 12.6). A Spanish blog adds a 65m hurdles won by S. Melly (unconfirmed).

name: Jeux Athlétiques Internationaux Féminins / 2e Meeting International d'Éducation Physique Féminine
venue: Tir aux Pigeons, Casino gardens (swimming at Stade Nautique du Port)
notes: Festival 15-23 Apr (16-23 per runyoung50). Rol photos date athletics to 16-17 Apr; swimming was 20-23 Apr. 60m had heats (Lines won a heat on 16 Apr). Hurdles were 74m per a Rol caption (Wright, 17 Apr); Wikipedia says 65m. The pentathlon's 60m/300m are excluded.

name: Jeux Athlétiques Féminins de Monte-Carlo (3es Jeux Féminins)
notes: Dates per Wikipedia, citing the Nice press of 5-7 Apr. Paris dailies of 4 Apr already name Callebout and Lowman with Monte-Carlo, so athletics may have begun earlier (unverified). Hurdles 65m (Lowman 11.3). Last Monte Carlo edition.

name: Women's International and British Games (1924 Women's Olympiad)
notes: One-day meeting on Bank Holiday Monday, run by WAAA/FSFI with News of the World, Sporting Life and Daily Mirror. 120yh had heats (Lines ran 17.4, a WR, in her heat); heat count unknown. The 1000m walk is excluded.
